title: Update daily-agent.sh to use git worktree
description:
The daily agent currently works directly in the main repo on a feature branch. This can cause conflicts if someone is also working in the repo.

Update to use a worktree like curator-agent.sh does:
- Create worktree at /home/ubuntu/coding-jams-daily-wip/ (sibling to main repo)
- Work in the worktree, not the main repo
- Clean up worktree after PR is created (or keep for debugging)

Reference curator-agent.sh for the pattern.
